TC-17/S02.title: Edit -> copy -> re-edit -> re-copy, cancel, toggle round-trip, local hosts only, both contexts
TC-17/S02.detail: pr-tc17-s02-copy.spec.ts, two variants (note stored as sections = how 8b4be94a stores a generated note; note stored as plain text). Stated parts (UAT TC-17 steps 4-5, TFA-92595 AC 3, UAT 3.3) pass in both variants and both modes: a1/a3/a5/a6 each Copy to EMR holds the whole latest saved note and never the replaced marker; a4 a cancelled edit is not copied; a7 only localhost:6473 / 127.0.0.1:4510/4511 contacted while copying. Our own added check a2 (an unsaved draft survives note -> tasks -> note) fails in the sections variant only: the section editor stays open but is reset to the saved text, the draft QA-EDIT-2 is lost (plain-text variant keeps it). Not in the UAT or the ticket: QA-improvement candidate, not a bug. Tripwire clean.
